content:
maria: Hey @eng-platform — I opened a PR that touches services/model-serving and infra/k8s manifests. Need guidance on who can approve/merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/214

ton y: quick ping — that PR looks cross-cutting. CODEOWNERS usually routes model-serving to @ml-team and infra to @eng-infra-team, so you may need approvals from both.

kevin: Can you paste the diff or the files changed? If it's just resource/env tweaks eng-infra can probably sign off.

maria: pasted the main bits in the PR description. Also here's the relevant CODEOWNERS snippet I found:
```
# CODEOWNERS
/services/model-serving @ml-team
/infra/k8s @eng-infra-team
/deploy/* @platform-owners
```
Looks like the helm chart bump triggers platform owners too.

emma: I can review the model-serving changes (image/config). @kevin — do you or @sasha want to take infra?

kevin: :thumbsup: I can take infra in ~30m. If it's only DEFAULT_MODEL and replica bump I can approve, but we'll leave a comment about resource requests.

maria: The blocker is release timeline — we need to merge today. Can we do a manual approval route or a temporary exception?

ton y: If urgent we can do a manual approval but must record it on the PR. Add a short note like `manual-approval: eng-platform/urgent` to the PR description and ping here. I'll escalate to @sasha if needed.

kevin: Reviewed infra diff. Only changes are env var DEFAULT_MODEL=redwood-v2 and replicas: 3 -> 4. Left one inline comment about requests, but approving infra side.

emma: Model-serving LGTM, added approval.

maria: Thanks! @tony can you merge or grant me merge rights for this PR? Also should we add me to CODEOWNERS to avoid future blocks?

ton y: I'll merge once CI is green. I won't add you to CODEOWNERS ad-hoc — open a PR to change CODEOWNERS if you need long-term ownership. For this hotfix we do manual recorded approval.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green.

maria: Merged — thanks kevin, emma, tony :party_parrot:

kevin: Thanks — please follow up with a short retrospective on who to CC next time so we don't hit the same triage delay.

maria: Will do, adding an ACTION item to update CODEOWNERS and doc the approval flow.
